components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Harbor Teal commitment control — Send, Download, New chat, empty-state CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0D9488; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0D9488; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: #DC2626; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #DC2626; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Destructive
components.css: .ds-btn-outline-destructive { background: transparent; color: #DC2626; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #DC2626; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline-destructive:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-outline-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #DC2626; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Composer Field
components.description: Multiline chat input on Mist Surface with Soft Seam border.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-end; padding: 12px; border-top: 1px solid #D5DEDC; background: #FAFAF8; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(12,18,17,0.12); } .ds-input-composer { flex: 1; background: #F0F4F3; color: #14201F; border: 1px solid #D5DEDC; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; min-height: 44px; max-height: 120px; resize: none; } .ds-input-composer::placeholder { color: #D5DEDC; } .ds-input-composer:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0D9488; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-composer .ds-btn-primary { background: #0D9488; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; }

components.name: User Bubble
components.html: What's a good hiking checklist?
components.css: .ds-bubble-row { display: flex; padding: 6px 16px; } .ds-bubble-row-user { justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-bubble-user { max-width: 85%; background: #0D9488; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #D5DEDC; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Assistant Bubble
components.html: Start with water, layers, and a map offline.
components.css: .ds-bubble-row { display: flex; padding: 6px 16px; } .ds-bubble-row-assistant { justify-content: flex-start; } .ds-bubble-assistant { max-width: 85%; background: #F0F4F3; color: #14201F; border: 1px solid #D5DEDC; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Confirm Sheet
components.description: Bottom confirm panel over scrim — soft lift exception.
components.html:
Delete conversation?

This cannot be undone.
components.css: .ds-sheet-scrim { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45); padding: 24px 0 0; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-sheet-confirm { background: #F0F4F3; border: 1px solid #D5DEDC; border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(12,18,17,0.12); } .ds-sheet-title { margin: 0 0 12px; font-family: Lora, Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #14201F; } .ds-sheet-body { margin: 0 0 16px; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; color: #14201F; } .ds-sheet-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-btn-ghost { flex: 1; background: transparent; color: #14201F; border: 1px solid #D5DEDC; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0D9488; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sheet-actions .ds-btn-destructive { flex: 1; background: #DC2626; color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Tab Navigation
components.description: Three-tab bar — active Harbor Teal tint + Lucide icons.
components.css: .ds-tab-nav { display: flex; background: #FAFAF8; border-top: 1px solid #D5DEDC; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 8px; min-height: 44px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #14201F; font-family: Raleway, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-active { color: #0D9488; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0D9488; outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview:
LocalChat looks like a private pocket vault for on-device conversation — calm, precise, and sealed. Harbor Teal is the lock mark: rare, actionable, never decorative wallpaper. Surfaces stay Warm Paper by day and Deep Ink by night so the vault feels quiet rather than theatrical.

The system is refined and restrained: soft 16px corners, hairline seams, Lucide icons, and typography that does the talking (Lora for titles, Raleway for chat). Depth is mostly tonal; a single soft ambient lift is reserved for the composer bar and confirm sheets — never a floating card stack. Motion is short (150–300ms press feedback, streaming caret when allowed) and always yields to Reduce Motion.

Confirmed visual rejections: purple/indigo “AI” gradients, emoji as structural icons, hover-only affordances, and pure black #000000 flats that smear on OLED.
keyCharacteristics: Pocket Vault metaphor — privacy reads as quiet teal, not neon chrome
Single accent (Harbor Teal) on ≤~10% of any screen
Flat lists with soft lift only on composer and sheets
Light and dark are first-class; appearance follows system by default

rules.name: The One Lock Rule
rules.body: Harbor Teal appears on interactive commitment (send, download, active tab, user bubble) — not as page washes, hero gradients, or decorative chips filling the screen.

rules.name: The No Purple AI Rule
rules.body: Never introduce purple, indigo, or multi-stop neon gradients as “AI branding.”

rules.name: The Chat Legibility Rule
rules.body: Message body stays Raleway ≥16px with ~1.5 line-height; never shrink chat text to fit more chrome.

rules.name: The Soft-Lift Exception
rules.body: Shadows are not a default card language. If it isn’t the composer or a sheet, it stays flat.

dos: Do treat Harbor Teal as the single lock accent for commitment actions and active state.
Do keep chat body at ≥16px Raleway with ~1.5 line-height.
Do support light and dark as equal themes; avoid pure #000000 large flats.
Do show unfit models as muted + disabled with an explicit RAM reason.
Do respect Reduce Motion (crossfade / no caret pulse).
Do keep touch targets ≥44pt with ≥8pt gaps; Lucide (or one vector set) only.
donts: Don't use purple/indigo gradients or “AI startup” glow stacks.
Don't use emoji as nav, settings, or structural icons.
Don't put drop shadows on list cards or chat bubbles.
Don't invent a second brand accent; Alert Red is semantic only.
Don't rely on hover-only affordances — this is phone-first.
Don't place the composer under the keyboard or home indicator.
